findings.desc: AGENTS.md / B-d854 checklist evidence — acceptance-blocking missing proof: CHK-001:happy:0 and CHK-003:happy:0 claim a 26-row RED-to-GREEN audit, but rg -n "26-row|AGENTS_RED_GREEN|RED_GREEN" .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-d854 AGENTS.md finds only summary prose in checklist.json; there is no row-by-row ledger, command, captured RED output, captured GREEN output, or signed receipt mapping each of the 26 asserted corrections to an authoritative source. The existing mechanical checks cover Unicode, a small token inventory, and 20 command names, not the claimed 26 behavioral rows. Because the user explicitly requested evidence that the previously identified issues were RED then GREEN, this unsupported aggregate claim blocks acceptance. Add a reproducible 26-row artifact/evidence record and bind its exact command/output to current AGENTS.md before re-review. severity: high
findings.resolvedReason: The committed 26-row audit ledger in docs/audits/AGENTS-current-version-audit.md and commit 46197017 provide durable RED commands, authority references, and GREEN receipts; node tests/AGENTS.verify.mjs --final exits 0.

findings.desc: AGENTS.md:55-58 conflicts with the current canonical reviewer contract. The guide says Never directly read or write Story or fixture JSON, while review_run_start for this same Story requires the reviewer to read .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-d854/background.md, plan.md, and checklist.json. The managed thin block at AGENTS.md:9 correctly prohibits direct edits only, and direct reads do not bypass signatures, hashes, locks, receipts, or lifecycle mutation validation. This overbroad prohibition makes a reviewer violate AGENTS.md in order to satisfy the canonical role prompt and therefore fails the requested prompt-consistency audit. Narrow the rule to direct writes/mutations, and state that bounded read-only reviewer inputs named by a canonical prompt are permitted; retain CLI reads for ordinary state inspection. severity: high

AGENTS.md:18-23 / Story verification evidence — acceptance requires a claim-by-claim audit ledger and the user specifically asked whether every previously identified issue has RED then GREEN proof. The only persisted docs_check note says “the 26-row RED/GREEN matrix passed” and lists a few broad source ranges, but no 26 rows, per-row baseline failure, final pass condition, authoritative citation, command, exit code, or captured output are present. A reviewer cannot reproduce or inspect the claimed matrix, so the proof request is not delivered even though the final wording appears to address the 24 major and 2 low-priority groups. Fix by recording and presenting the actual 26-row RED→GREEN ledger, with each row independently tied to the baseline line, final line, authority and runnable evidence.

AGENTS.md:16-566 — “translate the complete root AGENTS.md” was implemented as an undocumented consolidation, not a fully accounted translation. The baseline has 598 lines/32 fences/41 table rows/11 blockquotes; the final has 566/20/21/0. A deterministic command inventory finds 14 still-current repository-local CLI examples removed from runnable guidance (aux_detail, aux_diagnose, aux_scan, aux_sync, aux_trace, decision_get, decision_set, fixture_batch_add, gap_log, story_create, test_fixture, test_story, understanding_get, understanding_set; each --help exits 0). The evidence supplies only the blanket sentence “obsolete and duplicate legacy sections consolidated” rather than listing each intentional removal and justification, contrary to CHK-002:edge:0 and the complete-translation request. Restore faithful English coverage or provide a complete itemized audit proving every deletion is an authorized consistency correction rather than lost content.

AGENTS.md:492-530 / CHK-001:adversarial:0 and CHK-003:adversarial:0 evidence — the active-command checker is a false-green oracle for exact examples. Its regex retains only a command name (plus the codex subcommand), then invokes `<command> --help`; it discards every documented argument and never runs concrete read-only examples or validates mutating payloads in a disposable repository/schema path. Therefore an example with a nonexistent flag, wrong payload field, or invalid value would still pass. This fails the pinned intent that every active example be operational and that read-only/mutating examples be exercised safely. Replace it with an extractor that validates each complete example and include a deliberately malformed-argument mutation in addition to the nonexistent-command sentinel.

AGENTS.md:220-225,307-313,439-440,494-529 — acceptance-blocking false-green in the active-command verification: these blocks contain concrete phase-changing, mutating, and read-only examples, but the recorded CHK-001:adversarial:0 / CHK-003:adversarial:0 checker extracts only the first command token (special-casing codex) and runs `<command> --help`. It never validates the displayed argv or placeholder structure, never executes read-only examples with repository-valid arguments, and never schema-validates mutating examples in an isolated repository, despite both must-intents requiring exactly those checks. A command can therefore have valid help while every documented invocation is malformed and the receipt still reports PASS. Replace the prefix-only smoke with a case ledger that binds each active example to its exact argv and either executes it read-only, validates it through the registered schema in isolation, or explicitly classifies it as conceptual; keep the invalid sentinel. severity: high

CHK-001:happy:0 and CHK-003:happy:0 lack concrete verificationEvidence for the claimed 26-row RED-to-GREEN audit. The only persisted evidence is a docs_check note that says the matrix passed and names broad sources; git grep finds no row-by-row ledger, per-row baseline failure, final pass condition, authoritative line, command, exit code, or captured output. A fresh reviewer cannot rerun or inspect the aggregate claim, so both must intents remain uncovered. Add a durable 26-row ledger and bind rerunnable receipts to the current AGENTS.md. severity: high

CHK-001:adversarial:0 and CHK-003:adversarial:0 are not covered by the recorded command checker. Its implementation extracts only command names and appends --help; it never executes read-only examples with their documented arguments and never validates mutating example payloads in an isolated repository or against the registered schema. Independent mutation proof appended `proof-or-stop story_get --storyId`: the real invocation exits 1 for invalid boolean storyId, while the checker input set is unchanged and would remain green. The invalid-command sentinel tests name rejection only, not example validity. severity: high

CHK-002:edge:0 lacks the deterministic structural and technical-token inventory it requires. The evidence checks marker/fence balance, aggregate heading/table counts, and only 18 selected tokens; it does not compare list nesting, blockquotes, fence language tags, links, all paths, command/role identifiers, JSON keys, phase/story identifiers, or enumerate every intentional difference. Independent mutation proof changed `scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs` to `scripts/WRONG.mjs`, and the recorded checker still accepts the document. This must intent remains uncovered. severity: high

CHK-002:adversarial:0 lacks valid comprehensive semantic-drift evidence. Its manual_transcript has no result or tool receipt, and its detector checks only three literal phrases. Independent mutation proof changed the lifecycle rule from `Document implementation changes are allowed only here` to `allowed in every phase`; the detector still accepts it. The intent requires review of every normative/lifecycle-sensitive sentence and representative polarity/modality/current-versus-legacy mutations, so a three-string detector plus an unsupported review note is insufficient. severity: high

CHK-003:edge:1 is only partially covered. The evidence records the local invocation string and version plus the global invoked path, version, and canonical realpath, but it computes `fs.realpathSync` only for `/opt/homebrew/bin/proof-or-stop`; it never records the canonical resolved realpath for the repository-local `node bin/proof-or-stop.js` authority even though the intent explicitly requires invoked path and canonical realpath for each runtime. Add the local canonical path/realpath to a fresh mechanical receipt. severity: high
